ELEVATED FOUR-BEDROOM DETACHED BUNGALOW WITH DETACHED GARAGE & STUNNING CATHEDRAL VIEWS WALKING DISTANCE TO CAVAN TOWN CENTRE

Smith Property proudly present to the market No. 4 Cathedral View, Cavan, an exceptionally well-maintained detached bungalow occupying an elevated position in one of Cavan Town`s most desirable residential settings.

As its name suggests, Cathedral View enjoys magnificent views towards the iconic Cathedral of Saints Patrick & Felim, with an enviable outlook across Cavan Town and the surrounding countryside. Positioned within a quiet and exclusive cul-de-sac of just twelve detached homes, the property combines a peaceful residential setting with exceptional convenience, being only a short stroll from Cavan Town Centre via Cock Hill and within easy reach of shops, schools, cafés, restaurants, sporting facilities, healthcare services and an extensive range of everyday amenities.

Extending to approximately 112.8 sq.m. (1,214 sq.ft.), this attractive bungalow has been thoughtfully designed to provide spacious, practical accommodation all on one level, making it equally suitable for families, those seeking to downsize, or purchasers looking for a home that offers long-term accessibility.

The accommodation is both bright and generously proportioned throughout and comprises a welcoming entrance hallway, a spacious main living room, a versatile second reception room suitable as a sitting room, dining room or family room, a well-appointed kitchen with adjoining utility room, four generously sized bedrooms, each comfortably accommodating a double bed, together with a family bathroom and an en-suite serving the principal bedroom.

Further enhancing the accommodation is a partially converted attic, providing valuable additional space ideally suited as a home office, hobby room or extensive storage area, offering flexibility to meet the demands of modern family living.

Externally, the property occupies an independent, mature site with well-maintained gardens and a private rear patio area, creating an ideal setting for outdoor dining and relaxation. A detached garage extending to approximately 16.6 sq.m. (179 sq.ft.), complete with roller shutter door, provides secure parking, workshop space or additional storage.

Presented in excellent decorative order throughout, the home has been carefully maintained and offers a bright, warm and welcoming atmosphere from the moment you enter. Its combination of spacious accommodation, elevated views, quality presentation and highly convenient location makes it a particularly attractive proposition for a wide range of purchasers.

Whether you are seeking a retirement home with all accommodation on one level, a quality family residence close to schools and amenities, a first home in an established neighbourhood, or a property to trade up to in one of Cavan Town`s most sought-after addresses, No. 4 Cathedral View represents an outstanding opportunity to acquire a home of lasting quality in a prime residential location.

Viewing by appointment through the sole selling agents. Call our Cavan office on 049 4362244 to make an appointment.
